title: Mandatory tag is missing
cardHint: A tag the class must carry is missing (a process: customer facing or internal). SACM sets it, and asks Process Management when it cannot tell.

playbook.askWhenUnsure: Cannot tell which type: ask Process Management

message.subject: Missing tag
message.intro: A mandatory tag is missing on these CIs.
message.ask: Could you tell us the right value for each CI? We will update ServiceNow for you.
message.why: The mandatory tags say what kind of CI it is. Reports and rules depend on them.

askByTeam.process-management: Is each process customer facing or internal? Please {reply}, and we will set the tag in ServiceNow.
